name: Honki no Dokkiri o Shikaketa Kekka Doushitemo Shinin ga Deru
original_name: 本気のドッキリを仕掛けた結果どうしても死人が出る
source:
It was supposedly just a schemed up prank.
Why on earth did I have sex with my close friend?
Why did someone end up dead...?

Contains both all age version and adult only version.
Recommended to listen to all age version first.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE205538.html]DLsite English[/url]]

据说这只是一场精心策划的恶作剧。

为什么有人最后死了……？

包含全年龄段版本和仅限成人版本。
建议先听全年龄段版本。
